title: València Tour
text:
Mr. Raza, Our driver was absolutely amazing. He was friendly arrived 1/2 hour early which gave us additional time to site see before we met our tour guide. Mr. Raza is an exceptional driver and I highly recommend him.

Our tour guide Adela was phenomenal she was so informative and absolutely the sweetest person. I highly recommend this tour. 

I am already planning my next trip and I hope these two individuals are available the next time I visit. 

Sincerely,
Yolanda Rivera
author: Yolanda_R
